## 2026-09-02 · every one was found by the thing before it

Nine items, three live exploits, six more defects. Not one came from me reading harder. Building a producer made the first exploit constructible; turning that probe into a gate found the second on its first run; making the CLI print what it checked showed it discarding the reader's own inputs; giving the floor a corpus leg found four rules it never had. I kept thinking the next find was skill. It was the previous artifact, asking a question I hadn't.
